education.degree: Master of Science in Applied Machine Learning
Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering
details: Relevant Coursework: Machine Learning, Artificial Neural Networks

bullets.text: Progressed from STEM Intern to Data Analyst to Data Scientist across ~4 years, scaling automated workflows from 4 to 18 (350% increase) and cutting manual work by 180+ hours/quarter within Goldman Sachs Asset Management division.
Trained SVM classification model analyzing trade settlement patterns, reducing pending trades by 40% and mitigating regulatory penalties by ~$65k/quarter; Applied SMOTE for class imbalance

Engineered a Loan Servicing Automation AI Agent (GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo, RAG with pgvector) coordinating a 10-module pipeline and 7 tools (PDF parsing, internal document store, PostgreSQL), with 2 human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints across 14 validation checks; saved 40 hrs/month and eliminated erroneous database writes
Built a computer vision OCR pipeline automating KYC compliance extraction for 4 additional teams at 96% accuracy
Modeled and queried data from 10+ systems into an automated KPI/KRI analytics pipeline (Python, SQL, pandas, statsmodels, Tableau), saving the equivalent of 3 FTEs
Designed a STEM training program covering ETL, data lakes, and Python automation; mentored 3 interns to full-time offers; program adopted as standard onboarding division-wide
Converted a Goldman Sachs loan-servicing prototype into a 10-agent LangGraph system with 2 parallel subgraphs and heterogeneous LLM routing (Claude Sonnet / GPT-4o-mini by cost-quality tradeoff)

Built tool-misuse controls: 15 least-privilege tools, Pydantic schema validation at every agent boundary, idempotent DB writes, confidence-gated routing, and 4 HIL interrupts before any irreversible write across 22 validation checks

Containerized with Docker and deployed to Kubernetes (GKE Autopilot) using GitHub Actions CI/CD for automated build, testing, image publishing, and rolling deployments; exposed agents via the A2A protocol for interoperable agent-to-agent communication

Rebuilt a Goldman Sachs settlement-fail SVM on 3.1M synthetic trades (~3% fail rate, 20 features), benchmarking 12 Logistic Regression, linear/RBF SVM, and XGBoost variants tuned with Optuna and time-series CV; XGBoost led at 0.333 PR-AUC (~7x the random baseline)
Prevented data leakage with time-based train/validation/test splits and SMOTE applied only to training data, enforced by automated tests in CI

Calibrated scores on validation (Brier 0.213 to 0.035) and checked GPU TreeSHAP against planted ground truth (SHAP rank correlation 0.96, all 3 planted interactions ranked top 3 of 190 pairs); shipped an interactive Streamlit demo on Hugging Face Spaces
Compressed FinBERT (109M params, financial sentiment) 9.1x from 437.9 MB to 47.7 MB via INT8 PTQ/QAT, knowledge distillation, and structured pruning across 7 benchmarked variants
Found that pruning 50% of attention heads improved val Macro F1 by +0.9 points; published weights to HuggingFace Hub with GitHub Actions CI/CD
Developed a CNN-Transformer hybrid achieving 81.78% accuracy (0.480 MCC) on 24 years of S&P 500 regime classification, outperforming 6 baseline architectures
Engineered leakage-safe time-series pipeline with macroeconomic indicators and Gaussian HMM-based regime labelling; optimized thresholds to achieve 88.4% F1 under 68/32 class imbalance

publication.citation: Alzheimer's Disease Detection (MATLAB, MLP-ELM, GLCM). Designed MLP-Extreme Learning Machine, achieving 95% accuracy on 6,400+ MRI scans using GLCM features; published IEEE research with 17% improvement over baselines; presented at IEEE International Conference
